kit_page.name: scene_options_kit
kit_page.summary: Director hotkeys, their reference list, and what a scene file saves.

kit_row.help: Turns the Director machinima hotkeys on or off. On by default; focused text fields and tools win over them.
kit_row.keywords: hotkeys keys shortcut f2 f3 f8 enable
kit_row.label: Hotkeys

kit_row.help: Add me to the cast at login: Adds your avatar to the Director cast after the next login.
kit_row.label: Add me at login

kit_row.help: Reference list of the Director hotkeys (F2 to F8, 1 to 9, Alt+1 to 9, Esc) and when each one works.
kit_row.keywords: shortcuts keys reference list f2 f3 f4 f5 f6 f7 f8
kit_row.label: Shortcuts
kit_row.text: F2 console / F3 ACTION-CUT / F4 CUT / F5 reset marks / F6 pose clones / F7 take play-pause / F8 set marks / 1-9 camera slots / Alt+1-9 animation slots / Esc CUT.

kit_row.help: Lists what scene files save, and the items not saved yet such as exposure, lens looks and weather.
kit_row.keywords: scene save file categories not saved
kit_row.label: Saved in file
kit_row.text: Saved: cast, marks, groups, paths, subjects, actor styling, transport, camera/switcher, orbit, temporal, VCam, light rigs, Rig Rim, Roto Ink and Tron. Not yet saved: exposure, lens looks, DoF, haze, shafts, weather, scene-light EVs, Pose Polish and Diopter.
